# Demo skill

You MUST ALWAYS read architecture.md, database.md and deployment.md before every edit.

## Steps

1. Think step by step and write out your reasoning before answering.
2. Dispatch the implementer with implementer-prompt.md.
3. After the implementer finishes, double-check every change and run the full test suite.
4. Stop and ask the user for review after the first implementation.

This rule was added after the 2026-08-12 incident (issue #482) where the agent deleted a table.
